old_password.meaning: Old password; nonblank after trimming and containing no NUL. Sent on stdin; the aggregate serialized child document has a 65536-byte cap.

new_password.meaning: New password; nonblank after trimming and containing no NUL. Sent on stdin; the aggregate serialized child document has a 65536-byte cap.

planned.meaning: Optional plan request; null or absent becomes false. The child is still dispatched; a reported planned mutation is refused.

changed.meaning: Backend-reported change, or null when unknown.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Backend-reported change, or null when unknown.

could-change.meaning: Backend affordance or a default array containing the operation.

attempt.meaning: Backend attempt or the adapter default.

final.meaning: Backend final result or the adapter default.

attempted-operation.meaning: Operation after dispatch, absent before dispatch.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists literal adapter outcomes. The backend may also pass through its own signal: a nonempty lowercase-or-digit-starting token of at most 128 bytes using lowercase letters, digits, underscore, period, colon or hyphen.
